entries.title: Your crew gather on a growing ring
entries.body: Crewmates now start on one ring around your first mate, which widens a little with each new crewmate. Past 24, a second ring opens inside it, tilted differently and turning the other way. There are never more than two rings; with more than 48 crewmates, both rings fit them closer together.

picture.alt: Thirty-three crewmates around the first mate: 24 on a wide outer ring and 9 on a smaller, differently tilted ring inside it
